name: opane
author: Cresmar Mat-an
description: opane is an application, window, input, and interface library for C++20 on SDL3, with Direct3D 12, Vulkan, and Metal backends.
tagline: Application, window, input, and interface library for C++20.
lead: Open a window, build an interface, and style it the way you want. Direct3D 12, Vulkan, and Metal run the same HLSL shaders, compiled for each backend when you build.
example_text: One call starts the application; elements are added to a tree and laid out for you; the frame loop hands you the time step.

features.title: Application and window
features.text: One call opens a window on Direct3D 12, Vulkan, or Metal and runs the frame loop, with input, textures, audio, and your program's own icon.

features.icon: <rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="14" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="14" rx="1"/>
features.title: Element tree and layout
features.text: Stacks, flexible sizes, custom layouts, and scale-plus-offset positioning, with pointer capture, event bubbling, and keyboard focus.

features.icon: <rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="2"/><path d="M3 9h18"/><path d="M9 21V9"/>
features.title: Widgets and docking
features.text: Buttons, text fields with undo, virtualized lists and trees, menus, dialogs, tooltips, and docking with tabs, splits, and saved layouts.

features.title: A look of your own
features.text: Gradients, nine-slice images, soft shadows, frosted glass, per-state looks with smooth transitions, skins, and theme files that reload when saved.

features.title: Text
features.text: UTF-8 text that stays sharp at any size, kerning, mixed fonts and colours in one line, word wrapping, and the platform's text input.

features.title: Extending opane
features.text: Write your own elements, put an HLSL shader on any element with hot reload, or draw directly with signed-distance primitives.

sibling.name: ludifex
sibling.text: ludifex adds 2D and 3D worlds: physics, a physically based renderer with optional ray tracing, animation, and sound. opane hosts a world full-window or inside a viewport in your layout, and the two share one device and one audio mix.
